g.text: Activity diagram — UC2 Run a trip, including GPS and network interruptions
HTTP 409 not in service or busy)
After a page reload the app resumes the
source of the trip's latest accepted position;
if there is none yet, it shares nothing
until the driver chooses a source.
Wait for the next GPS reading
(simulator every 3 s, device GPS at most every 2 s)
(batches of at most 50, each with sentAt)
(waits for an upload in flight, at most 5 s)
Validate, sort by time, reject duplicates,
out-of-order, too old (> 10 min) and impossible jumps
(sent to all viewers on the next
event-loop turn, after the steps below)
